description: Account-wide monitoring rollup in ONE call, with no monitor id: service status ('operational' or 'degraded'), active/paused/total counts across every monitor on the account, and pending/delivered/failed delivery counts from the last 24 hours. Takes no arguments. A key with zero monitors gets zeroed counts back, not an error. Cost: Free per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/monitoring/monitor-health
name: twitter_monitor_account_health
